images.title: Padma turning 3 right angles anti-clockwise from West
images.purpose: Show a child on a compass facing West and turning 1, 2 and 3 right angles anti-clockwise to face South, East and North, which is the same as 1 right angle clockwise.
images.composition: A compass with four signboards, the child at the centre and three curved arrows, and the working written on the right.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. COMPASS, centre (480, 408): two thin grey #6B7280 lines (6 px) crossing at the centre, one vertical 520 px long and one horizontal 520 px long. Four rounded signboards (pale cream #FFF8E7 fill, thin dark outline, 40 px bold dark sans-serif): North at the top end (480, 120), East at the right end (790, 408), South at the bottom end (480, 700) and West at the left end (170, 408), each 150 px wide and 54 px high. At the centre a round child (head circle 60 px, teal #0072B2 shoulder shape) with a solid teal arrow 110 px long pointing left to West, labelled start (30 px, bold, dark) near the arrow at (330, 360). Three curved amber #E69F00 arrows with arrowheads on a circle of radius 190 px, all going anti-clockwise: from West to South (the lower left), from South to East (the lower right) and from East to North (the upper right), numbered 1, 2 and 3 on the arrows in dark bold (36 px). A small amber arrowhead at the North end marks where the child ends. RIGHT SIDE: four lines of dark bold text (44 px) left aligned at x 900: West at y 240, 3 right angles anti-clockwise at y 320, ends at North at y 400, and, smaller (36 px) at y 480 and y 530, the same as 1 right angle clockwise, in two lines: the same as 1 right / angle clockwise. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
the signboards in places other than North top, East right, South bottom, West left
images.takeaway: 3 right angles anti-clockwise from West end at North, the same as 1 right angle clockwise.
images.description: A compass with the child starting at West and three anti-clockwise right-angle turns to South, East and North, with 3 right angles anti-clockwise = North written beside it.
images.context: Concept image for Finding the Final Direction After Right-Angle Turns. It follows the idea of the compass and the table of turns in your maths book and shows the concept's own example of 3 right angles anti-clockwise from West.
images.teaching_notes: Walk the child round one right angle at a time. The slip to watch is turning the wrong way round the compass.

image_decisions.why: The compass with the three numbered arrows shows each right-angle step and where the child ends.
